scene: Out the back, rain sweeps across a busy transit hub plaza.
picture: A flat side view of an outdoor transit plaza under gentle rain. On the far left sits a yellow street tram on tracks. The player in yellow raincoat, round afro, and green boots stands left of centre holding a red umbrella. In the centre waits a purple night bus. On the far right, a blue ferry floats.
